entries.msgstr: A smoke signal that marks an area for a battleship artillery salvo, causing damage to enemy equipment and objects located there.
Have Gefr. Keller use the captured German radio to transmit a false order, directing enemies to investigate a specified location.
Send Capt. Dubois on reconnaissance to a specified location. While he is away, his vehicle remains stationary. The ability continues to operate until canceled.
Call in an airstrike on a designated position.
